title: Evidence: Damaged MacBook Screen

attachments.platform_description: Close-up photo showing crack in lower-right corner of the MacBook Pro screen. The crack extends approximately 3 inches diagonally from the corner. Multiple smaller fracture lines branch from the main crack.
attachments.title: Screen Damage

attachments.platform_description: Photo shows the FedEx shipping box with visible dent/crush damage on one corner. The dent corresponds to the location of screen damage.
attachments.title: Shipping Box

attachments.platform_description: Shows the laptop wrapped in a single layer of bubble wrap inside the shipping box. No additional padding or structural inserts are visible between the bubble wrap and the box walls.
attachments.title: Internal Packaging

submitted_text: The laptop was damaged when I opened the box. I have not used it at all. I would like a full refund so I can purchase a replacement.
